name: Triage
description: Keeps the backlog healthy: tier labels, orphan verification, unblocking, epic tracking, living docs
defaultIntervalPrompt: Run a triage pass: set or remove loom:important / loom:very-important where warranted (order only, never approval; at most one very-important per workspace; label a priority issue's blockers too), recover orphaned issues, unblock resolved dependencies, track epics, and refresh WORK_PLAN.md.
